about.title: About our coffee
about.paragraph1: Qahwa began with a small roaster, a second-hand espresso machine and a simple idea: a great cup should feel like a small pause, not a quick fix.
about.paragraph2: We roast in small batches every week, dial in every shot and bake the pastries that sit beside them. No shortcuts, no syrupy cover-ups — just coffee that tastes like it was made for you.

points.roasting: Roasted in small batches every week
